calls.title: The public adoption page: settled credentials only, in the CPL/AI look
calls.text: Answered on Open Asks Sheet 147 cards 3 and 4: settled credentials only, in Malone's CPL/AI look. Its name is still Sam's to give.

calls.title: Fold the reference's AP titles under College Board's official names
calls.text: 74 local titles under non-official AP twins move to the official names, 46 of them stamped; held because it re-files stamped titles. With no reply they stay where they are.

calls.title: How a rule added in the Exhibits tab gets run
calls.text: Recommended: a request row the tab writes and a routine that builds the rule, runs the dry run and writes it back for Turn on or Discard. With no reply the tab keeps the paste for a session.
